text: {"features":[{"name":"Production engineering depth","description":"How strong the letter's evidence is of substantial experience testing, maintaining, and launching production software systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Meets the baseline only on paper, usually with a few years and a small number of launched services and little sense of ownership breadth."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows qualifying production experience with some responsibility for live services, but the scope still feels modest."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Presents solid production experience with clear involvement in testing, maintenance, and launches across several services or years."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Demonstrates strong breadth or tenure through repeated launches, sustained service ownership, or clear progression in responsibility."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Conveys an extensive production track record with broad ownership and a credible progression from keeping systems running to repeatedly shipping them."}]},{"name":"Go proficiency","description":"How convincingly the letter shows that Go is a strong, role-relevant working language.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Identifies Go as a language used but gives no meaningful detail about depth or what was built with it."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"States that Go is a regular or primary language, yet provides only limited context about its use."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Connects Go to concrete back-end or production-service work in a way that shows practical proficiency."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows Go as a primary tool in meaningful back-end systems ownership or infrastructure work."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes Go central to the profile and ties it directly to building the kinds of back-end systems this role requires."}]},{"name":"Python proficiency","description":"How convincingly the letter shows that Python is a strong, role-relevant working language.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Omits Python or leaves its role unclear."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions Python mainly as light scripting or small utility work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes regular Python use for automation, analysis, internal tools, or services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows Python as production-grade with concrete examples that other engineers or systems depend on."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Positions Python as a major strength and connects it directly to dependable automation or AI-agent work relevant to the job."}]},{"name":"Algorithmic fluency","description":"How well the letter demonstrates strong command of data structures and algorithms through concrete engineering examples.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no concrete evidence of strength with data structures or algorithms."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Claims algorithmic ability in broad terms or with a thin example."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Offers one clear example of improving a real system through a better algorithm or structure."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong fluency through specific redesigns or performance wins on nontrivial problems."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes algorithmic thinking a clear differentiator, with vivid examples of transforming difficult system behavior through sound design choices."}]},{"name":"AI engineering experience","description":"How strongly the letter shows practical experience building reliable AI or model-driven systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of AI or model-based product work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions AI interest or exposure without concrete shipped work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes building or shipping AI features in production."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows meaningful AI engineering experience and addresses evaluation, trustworthiness, or reliability."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents substantial, role-relevant AI work with concrete production use and a mature approach to making model-driven systems dependable."}]},{"name":"Agentic systems design","description":"How well the letter demonstrates experience architecting agent-based systems with clear boundaries and control mechanisms.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of designing agent-based systems."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions agents or autonomy only briefly and without architectural detail."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes building agentic systems with a recognizable split between agents and supporting services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Clearly explains an agent architecture, typically with Python agents operating inside constraints enforced by other infrastructure."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates strong architectural judgment about agentic systems, including autonomy, boundaries, auditing, or guardrails that map directly to the role."}]},{"name":"Security assessment practice","description":"How strongly the letter shows hands-on experience assessing systems for security weaknesses in a structured way.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of performing security assessments."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"References security reviews or instincts in general terms with little method or scope."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes recognizable assessment work such as threat modeling, code review, or formal reviews."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows substantive assessment experience across multiple contexts and mentions remediation or design follow-through."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Conveys mature assessment practice, treating security review as systematic engineering work tied to real fixes or design decisions."}]},{"name":"Vulnerability triage automation","description":"How directly and strongly the letter shows experience automating vulnerability intake, routing, deduplication, or response workflows.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of automating vulnerability handling."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions exposure to vulnerability queues or reports without clear ownership of automation."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes building some automation for vulnerability intake, classification, deduplication, or routing."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows direct ownership of a meaningful triage pipeline that materially reduced manual work."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents vulnerability-handling automation as a major accomplishment with clear end-to-end design and concrete leverage for the security team."}]},{"name":"Security automation insight","description":"How well the letter demonstrates understanding of security work as a scaling and systems problem rather than just a set of isolated reviews.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows little understanding of the specific scaling problem the team is trying to solve."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Expresses general interest in security tooling but frames the challenge loosely."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Recognizes that automation can reduce repetitive security toil and improve coverage."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Articulates the problem as a systems-design challenge involving scale, routing, triage, or multiplying expert judgment."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Offers especially sharp, role-specific insight into how automated tooling, agents, or variant analysis can expand security capacity across a large organization."}]},{"name":"Platform mindset","description":"How strongly the letter conveys motivation to work on foundational systems whose benefits propagate across many teams.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Says little about wanting leverage through shared infrastructure or foundational systems."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Briefly mentions scale or impact without explaining why platform work appeals."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Clearly expresses interest in infrastructure or foundation-layer engineering with broad downstream effect."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows a strong platform mindset by emphasizing shared systems, quiet reliability, or multiplier effects."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes foundational leverage central to the letter, convincingly framing past work and future goals around building systems other teams inherit."}]},{"name":"Developer empathy","description":"How well the letter shows awareness of the needs and constraints of the developer teams this role would support.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not show awareness of the developers who would use or benefit from the team's tools."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions helping engineers in passing without showing real understanding of their constraints."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Recognizes that security tooling should fit naturally into developer workflows."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows clear empathy for busy product teams and argues that good systems make the secure path the easy path."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates a strong service mindset toward developers, explaining security tooling in terms of defaults, usability, and removal of friction for the teams it serves."}]},{"name":"Systems engineering depth","description":"How much the letter shows sophistication with back-end, infrastructure, or distributed-systems design beyond routine application work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Offers no evidence beyond routine application development or small utilities."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions back-end or infrastructure work but with limited indication of complexity or reliability concerns."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Gives at least one concrete example of designing nontrivial back-end or distributed components."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong systems depth through examples involving fault tolerance, distributed state, replication, or other hard infrastructure problems."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes serious systems engineering a clear strength, with concrete examples of tackling demanding infrastructure where correctness and failure modes are central."}]},{"name":"Hands-on security practice","description":"How strongly the letter shows active security skill-building outside normal product engineering, such as CTFs or certifications.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of security practice beyond ordinary software engineering work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions a basic security credential or occasional security exercise with limited depth."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows ongoing practice through recurring CTF participation or a meaningful security certification."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Demonstrates strong hands-on security credibility, such as top CTF performance or demanding practical credentials like OSCP."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents attacker-minded practice as a major strength through sustained high-level results, rigorous practical credentials, or both."}]},{"name":"Independent engineering initiative","description":"How much the letter shows self-directed technical work outside assigned job duties, such as open-source maintenance or ambitious side projects.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows no meaningful self-directed technical work outside core job claims."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions a small personal project or occasional outside contribution with limited scope."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Provides clear evidence of self-directed work through a maintained side project or occasional open-source contributions."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong initiative via an active open-source project or a substantial personal build with real technical ambition."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates exceptional self-direction through stewardship of a real user-facing project or completion of ambitious side systems chosen to tackle hard engineering problems."}]},{"name":"Role targeting","description":"How specifically the letter is tailored to this Google Information Security Engineering role rather than to software jobs in general.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives a generic reason for applying that could fit many software roles."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Names security or back-end interest but only loosely ties it to this specific position."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Explains a credible reason for wanting this role and connects it to at least one stated responsibility."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong, specific motivation for this team, often referencing Google's scale, security culture, or the role's exact mandate."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes the application feel unmistakably targeted, with a precise and convincing explanation of why this particular role is the right next step."}]},{"name":"Career narrative","description":"How coherently the letter connects the applicant's past experiences to this role as a logical progression.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Reads as a disconnected list of qualifications with little story linking past experience to the role."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Suggests a direction of travel but with only a thin through-line."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Provides a coherent progression from prior work into security-oriented back-end engineering."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Builds a strong narrative arc that connects earlier experiences, current skills, and future goals."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Delivers an especially compelling progression in which the candidate's history makes this role feel like a natural and well-earned continuation."}]},{"name":"Evidence specificity","description":"How consistently the letter backs up claims with concrete examples, technologies, scope, or outcomes.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Relies mainly on generic claims and adjectives with little concrete support."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Includes a few specifics but leaves most important claims broad or weakly supported."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Supports major claims with concrete examples, technologies, or accomplishments."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Repeatedly backs claims with specific systems, outcomes, or scope that make the profile easy to trust."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Uses consistently concrete evidence, often with vivid examples or measurable impact, so that nearly every important claim feels well grounded."}]},{"name":"Writing polish","description":"How mechanically clean the letter is in spelling, grammar, and usage.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Contains frequent spelling, grammar, or usage errors that distract from the application and suggest weak attention to detail."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Has several noticeable mechanical errors, but the letter remains understandable and professional enough."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows generally solid mechanics with only occasional mistakes."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Is clean and professional, with at most a minor slip that does not affect credibility."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Is essentially error-free and reads as carefully proofread."}]},{"name":"Prose strength","description":"How engaging, fluent, and memorable the writing style is apart from basic mechanical correctness.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Uses flat, awkward, or formulaic language that does little to hold attention."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Communicates adequately but with limited energy, rhythm, or memorability."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Reads smoothly and professionally, with some engaging phrasing."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Uses confident, well-shaped prose that makes the candidate's points easy to absorb and remember."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Is notably vivid and persuasive, combining clarity with a distinctive professional voice that elevates the whole letter."}]}]}
